title: Altered State
description: Altered state cinematography makes the mind the location: smear, afterimage, wrong color, unstable time, optics and cutting that no sober observer would report. It is a bundle of techniques motivated by consciousness, not a single filter name.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Edges trail. Hue unhooks from the room.
A face leaves a stain. Focus and speed refuse to sit still.
The set may be an apartment. The picture is a nervous system.
Use it when perception is the plot: drugs, vertigo, dying, revelation. Pick a few physical tells and repeat them so the state has rules.
A smear plus a color unhook is a language. Everything at once is noise.
It is the wrong tool for a single clean optic (one fisheye, one flare) that the character would still recognize as the room. If the codec collapses, that is datamosh.
If two times overlay as density, that is double exposure. Altered state may borrow those, but it has to be motivated as seeing.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Combine a short list: long shutter smear, step-printed time, wrong white balance, afterimages, a diopter or a distorting optic, occasional overlay. Keep the body of the subject readable enough to stay in the scene.
Prompt: perception bent, edges trailing, color unhooked from the room, as if consciousness is slipping, not a random glitch pack.

sections.title: When to use it

blocks.text: A close interior where the frame warps as a character slips, trailing edges, hue wrong, time sticky. Do not apply it to a wide establishing shot that still has to map the street.

sections.title: Compared with similar shots

blocks.text: Dreamcore is a genre look of liminal rooms and childhood lighting gone wrong. Altered state is the perceptual event, often in an ordinary set.
Datamosh is codec collapse. Double Exposure is a stacked record.
Distortions are geometric lies in the glass. Altered state may include distortion, plus time and color that will not sit.
DreamcoreNostalgia with the safety removed.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: Enter the Void binds camera, smear, and color to a consciousness that will not stay in a body. Requiem for a Dream uses speed, close optics, and cutting as intoxication and crash.
Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas is the wide-angle, wrong-color cousin.

sections.title: What usually goes wrong

blocks.text: Wrong cousin: a single fisheye, a datamosh, or a dreamcore bedroom with no perceptual event. Tell: a clean room with one sticker effect, or total illegibility.
Fix: motivate two or three repeating tells, keep the subject locatable, let the room remain a room that is failing.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is altered state in film?
Subjective photography in which smear, afterimage, color, and time report a mind rather than a sober room. It is a motivated bundle, not one optic.
Altered state vs distortions
Distortions are geometric warps from glass or air. Altered state may use those, plus color and time errors, as consciousness. Distortion can be sober (a peephole). Altered state is not.
When should I use altered state?
When the mind is the location. Do not use it as decoration on coverage that still has to be geographically clear.
How do I prompt altered state for AI image or video?
Name two or three tells (trail, afterimage, wrong hue, sticky time) and say consciousness is slipping. Forbid a generic glitch overlay and keep the subject readable.
